cohort: Infants from the Finnish HELMi birth cohort
finding: Delivery mode, perinatal exposures, defecation frequency, parity/siblings, and infant gastrointestinal function were important factors associated with infant gut microbiota composition during the first two years of life.
mod_finding: The effect of parity/siblings on infant microbiota was modified by birth mode and exposure to intrapartum antibiotics.
